articles.title: OKX and ICE are bringing 'never-expiring' oil futures to 120 million crypto users
articles.snippet: The new partnership comes as Hyperliquid’s oli futures contracts that never expire have been a huge success with over $1.6 billion in 24-hour trading volume.

articles.title: XRP ETFs attract inflows amid wallet surge. bitcoin, ether funds struggle.
articles.snippet: Fresh inflows into XRP-linked funds and a spike in newly created wallets suggest some traders may be rotating into the token while trimming exposure to crypto’s largest assets.

articles.title: SEC approves Nasdaq to list Bitcoin index options on the exchange
articles.snippet: The cash-settled, European-style contracts will trade under the ticker QBTC on Phlx, but still require CFTC approval before trading can begin.

articles.title: Polymarket Hit By ‘Internal Top-Up’ Wallet Exploit, $700K Drained
articles.snippet: User funds remain safe after the incident, the prediction market platform said, with contracts and core infrastructure unaffected.
